hits.title: Restaurants are losing thousands a year to no-shows
hits.author: diner_ops
hits.story_text: We run three sites and lose four or five covers every Friday to people who book and never turn up. We pay $180/month for a booking system that still cannot take a deposit.

hits.comment_text: Is there software that automatically takes a deposit at booking? Everything I have tried makes you chase the customer manually.
hits.author: smallrestaurant
